conditional_refit: one selected config only; no CSV if none qualifies

diagnostic_groups.globally_observed: >=80% training-airing evidence from any training user
diagnostic_groups.use: diagnostics only; never model variants or selection objectives
diagnostic_groups.user_history_size: number of eligible programs with personal >=50% training evidence; <20 vs >=20

normalization_and_ranking.fallback: cutoff-specific >=80% training popularity restricted to the applicable candidate pool
normalization_and_ranking.fusion: weighted sum of normalized scores; no score rounding
normalization_and_ranking.normalization: per-user max normalization over eligible candidate scores

implementation.B: -P_ij / P_jj columnwise, zero diagonal; preserve negative coefficients
implementation.G: X.T @ X in float64, never integer co-occurrence
implementation.P: float64 inverse of G+lambda I using Cholesky factorization and solve against identity
implementation.S9: exact .70*normalized adjusted repeat50 + .30*normalized original AR80; do not renormalize S9
implementation.X: binary float64 CSR from all >=80% actual training interactions, one per user/program; all training users/items, including noncandidate history
implementation.fitting_order: sequential split, lambda; each fit reused for all four beta values; no replacements for resource failure
implementation.fusion_component: filter to eligible target candidates, clip completed prediction scores to zero, max-normalize positives separately per user
implementation.mapping: sorted training user indices and integer program IDs; no validation/test interactions in learned mapping
implementation.memory: estimate before allocation; conservative 8 dense item-square buffers + CSR Gram worst-case + cohort score arrays; fixed fit cap min(4 GiB, physical_memory/4); resource failures reported, no smaller model substituted
implementation.prediction: X_user @ B; no seen-item exclusion; missing users/items zero

independent_diagnosis: diagnostics/complete.json; produced in this session before EASE implementation

selection.objective: maximize smaller of the two gains
selection.remaining_exact_tie: retain Stage 9 rather than invent another rule
selection.tie_break_2: lower measured computational cost, summed across splits; shared EASE fit and scoring plus direct fusion runtime

splits: unchanged Stage 8 horizon12 and original10 labels/users/candidates/temporal rules
suggestion_source: external AI assistant Codex; not personal user analysis
uncertainty: overlapping historical periods, repeatedly used users/labels, descriptive selection-unadjusted intervals; not independent confirmation
